answer: The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 180 to 377 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the beacon identity is graded at all. Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the velvet audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
